signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

roles.title: Member of Product Staff, Technical Product Manager

bullets: Product Ownership & Roadmap Own and drive the product roadmap across developer experience, platform abstractions, and applied research.
Define product priorities grounded in real developer behavior, not hypothetical use cases.
Ensure clarity and alignment across teams on what is being built and why.
Drive execution across research, applied engineering, and platform teams.
Translate user and product signals into insights that meaningfully inform research direction and prioritization.
Help shape how world models are productized and understood, grounded in real behavior rather than theory.
Bring structure and operating cadence to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Identify leverage points where small product or system changes unlock outsized developer success.
